name: Junko Sekiguchi
source:
UI Designer

As the UI/UX designer at Hasou Web Solutions, Junko has a creative prowess that can be attributed to her interest in geeky things like games and anime. She makes no attempt to hide her interests but rather embraces them. Additionally, she has a predilection for spicy foods and an almost superhuman ability to tolerate them.

"We're fellow nerds, remember? Being comrades leads to me understanding you better, my little junior!"
